searchText: Doesn't look like there's any deneb specific API changes remaining. There's a small PR that adds a new SSE event (`block_gossip`) that needs review (I'm not up to date with the discussion yet) https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/405 ok cool theres also one around schema fix, after those two maybe we can create a release Is there a way to subscribe to your beacon nodes' proposed blocks (preferably SSZ encoded) in real time? Or should you subscribe to the `heads` event stream, then call `/eth/v2/beacon/blocks/{block_id}` and then convert to JSON? Sorry if this isn't the right forum for questions like this, would be happy to ask elsewhere I dont think there is a stream directly publishes exactly what you describe. So yea, subscribe to `head` or `block` event stream and filter from there. I could be wrong though subscribing to only your blocks is not possible you'd have to subscribe to all blocks, it wouldnt be real time but it would be once the BN gets to it, which should be fairly timely, and you'd need to filter for your proposer index manually.... So using a block subscription and filtering the data coming in would be kind of what you're asking, but not the timeliness factor... https://ethereum.github.io/beacon-APIs/#/Events/eventstream worth noting event streams are kind of weird, but that's the interface i was thinking, the block event specifically
